public static final RegistryObject<EntityType<NecromancerOrbEntity>> NECROMANCER_ORB = ENTITY_TYPES.register("necromancer_orb", () ->
            EntityType.Builder.<NecromancerOrbEntity>of(NecromancerOrbEntity::new, MobCategory.MISC)
                    .fireImmune()
                    .sized(0.5F, 0.5F)
                    .updateInterval(1)
                    .build(new ResourceLocation(MODID, "necromancer_orb").toString())
    );

rows.concrete_observation: Registered Necromancer ShootAttackGoal spawns delayed-form orb at animation action point. StraightMovingProjectile baseTick calls a server AABB entity overlap loop into onHitEntity(Entity); unlike tick ray path it contains no Forge onProjectileImpact check. Necromancer custom Entity overload skips undead Mob, otherwise sounds via parent, attempts magic hurt, gates only enchant effects on true/alive, then unconditionally ejects all passengers of the target root vehicle, adds projectile delta*2, sounds again, sets vanish40 and broadcasts event1. Hence hurtfalse does not guard root-vehicle topology changes; cancellation of the separate ray path is not evidence the explicit overlap path was canceled. Orb baseTick invokes parent damage BEFORE its own animation timers/motion freeze. canHitEntity does not exclude forming/vanishing, so qualifying repeated overlap can reset vanish timer; parent 200+40 lifetime is still a cap, not immortality. Client event1 sets vanish animation consumed by predicate; this cue is impact lifecycle, not proof HP/control succeeded.
rows.application_to_boss_immune: Audit every actual collision ingress and all physical/topological side effects, not only ray impact events or HP result. Record refused damage, dismount rejection, applied motion and attempted-impact animation as separate outcomes; root eject can affect other riders. Animation phase alone is not a control gate.
rows.semantic_dedup: One complete proposal merges overlap ingress, root-passenger side effect, repeated vanish reset and feedback lifecycle. Different from master dungeonsmobs-native-paired-impact-zones-share-attempt-history-not-health-success (two connected carriers consume shared attempts) and dungeonsmobs-native-stomp-knockback-cancellation-leaves-independent-vertical-control (event helper only guards XZ). Generic hurtfalse-followed-by-motion alone is support0; semantic adoption hinges on actual alternate native ingress plus root topology.
rows.limitations: No game/server/Forge event implementation executed. Native parent Projectile internal onHit dispatch not verified here; claim is limited to explicit AABB→Entity overload and separately shown ray branch, not universal event cancellation bypass. Feedback is not gray immune text, and duplicate impact sound remains two static calls without audibility proof. No claim that all contacts pass inherited canHitEntity or that late join reconstructs animation.

rows.concrete_observation: Orb overrides hurt false and unpickable false; parent projectile can reflect by attacker look and replace owner after invulnerability test, but that parent hurt body is overridden for this orb. Parent NBT saves acceleration power only in its own methods.
